fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. Joash says, "…let it be used to repair any damage found in the temple." ONE job. The money gets ONE job, and it doesn't wander off. Most of us can't say that about our paychecks. Mine shows up, takes one look at the bills, and vanishes by Tuesday.

problems.problem: The cookie jar's side hustles are vague, so the money-plan joke still feels mild rather than laugh-out-loud funny.
